From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudretail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor PO process for CloudRetail marketplace listing

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this — we want to move Redwood onto CloudRetail's marketplace and need to understand your payments / PO intake path so we can get procurement and finance aligned. Key asks from our side:

- Which PO template should we use (and can you accept supplier-side PO numbers)?
- Wire vs ACH preferences and what bank paperwork you require.
- Expected lead time from PO to first invoice and to listing activation.
- Any special vendor registration forms or payee tax forms we should complete.

Can you share the vendor onboarding packet and an estimated workback so I can brief our procurement team?

Appreciate it — copying our finance lead so they can follow up.

— Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudRetail Inc.
attachments: none
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudretail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor PO process for CloudRetail marketplace listing

Hi Sarah — great to connect. Welcome — excited to get Redwood listed. Quick answers and next steps below, plus I attached our PO template and bank setup form.

Short answers:
- Use the attached "CloudRetail_PO_Template_v3.pdf" (we accept supplier POs; PO number format: RW-CR-<6 digits>).
- We prefer ACH (US) and international wire for cross-border. For ACH we need the vendor bank setup form (attached) plus a voided check or bank letter.
- Typical lead time: once PO + bank paperwork are received, finance issues the first invoice within 7 business days; listing activation typically occurs within 3 business days after first invoice clears (depends on marketplace sync).
- Required paperwork: vendor bank form, W-9 (US vendors) or W-8BEN where applicable. If you need tax forms, we can push a short checklist to procurement.

Proposed workback (high-level):
1) Today: Monica shares attachments (done) and confirms billing contact.
2) 3 business days: CloudRetail returns PO + bank setup docs + tax form.
3) 7 business days: Redwood finance processes vendor record and issues invoice.
4) 3 business days after invoice clearance: marketplace listing activation.

Can you confirm who will own the forms on your side and the billing contact? Also, please send any internal reference numbers we should include on invoices.

Attachments (sent): CloudRetail_PO_Template_v3.pdf (PDF), vendor_bank_setup_form.xlsx (XLSX), Redwood_Seller_Onboarding_Checklist.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — I copied Vanessa from Marketplace Ops and Ben from Revenue Ops to handle any PO exceptions or special contract terms.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@cloudretail.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor PO process for CloudRetail marketplace listing

Hi Sarah / Monica — a couple of operational items from Marketplace Ops so finance can route correctly:

- HubSpot deal id: DL-2026-CR-089 (please include on the PO).
- PO number format we expect on any invoices: RW-CR-<6 digits> (Monica mentioned this).
- Required vendor docs for our AP intake: completed vendor_bank_setup_form.xlsx, W-9 (US) or W-8BEN (non-US), and the signed vendor agreement if you have one. For marketplace listings we also ask for the Org ID used in your marketplace console so we can map SKUs to the correct account.

Notes on payment terms: our standard is Net 30 from invoice date. If CloudRetail requires Net 45 or extended terms, please flag that now — exceptions must be approved by Revenue Ops.

One more thing: if CloudRetail wants Redwood to invoice to a different legal entity than the one on the PO, we need a formal addendum and the legal entity's tax ID.

Internal process pointer: once we receive the complete packet we create a vendor record in our AP system and assign a vendor code (usually 2–3 business days). Then finance schedules the first invoice.

Any questions on the documents, ping me directly and I can route to AP.

— Vanessa
Senior Marketplace Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor PO process for CloudRetail marketplace listing — final checklist & DocuSign

Thanks all — circling back with the final checklist and next steps from Revenue Ops. Below is the consolidated list we need from CloudRetail to complete vendor activation and begin billing.

Required (please return in one email):
- Signed PO (use attached CloudRetail_PO_Template_v3.pdf and include HubSpot deal id DL-2026-CR-089)
- Completed vendor_bank_setup_form.xlsx + supporting bank letter or voided check
- Tax form (W-9 for US, W-8BEN for non-US)
- Any legal addendum if invoice legal entity differs from PO legal entity

Optional (will speed up):
- Preferred remittance email for AP notifications
- Marketplace Org ID for automatic SKU mapping

DocuSign: I created a DocuSign envelope to collect the PO signature and vendor agreement (placeholder link below). If you prefer to attach signed PDF directly we can accept that too.
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/CR-PO-089

Workback reminder: after we receive the complete packet we expect vendor record creation in 2–3 business days and first invoice generation within 7 business days. If you need an expedited path (payment on receipt) we can request a one-time exception but will need procurement justification.
